diagnostic_findings: Observer-enabled all-layer CPU-empty captures can match while unobserved native-reference checks fail; active captures are diagnostic only.
Disabling CUDA fusion made a six-position CPU-empty control exact; disabling CUDA graphs alone did not.
Disabling only router/top-k fusion did not resolve the native-reference failure.
Mixed CPU/GPU expert execution still failed the unchanged 96-position gate with global CUDA fusion disabled.
A controlled layer-0 GPU case showed expert outputs near CPU values (~1e-7 relative), yet final logits differed substantially; this does not prove native equivalence.
Quantized fusion paths were prevented from bypassing the requested expert precision; CPU Q8_K activation semantics with FP32 scales were separately tested.
limitations: Technical generation rates measure execution, not preserved answer quality.
No Mistral rate is added to the main SYNAPSE speedup table.
Original strict coding failures remain failed in every profile; no generated code is executed.
Native-reference failures remain blocking for a native-equivalence or production-compatibility claim.
CPU-matching primitive results and same-placement pipeline checks are not substitutes for native-reference or broad quality checks.
